title: Simple Contracts
body: This mod adds simple contracts. Specifically, a Blank Contract, a Written Contract, a Signed Contract, and a Seal. How to use the mod: 1. First, craft a Blank Contract (its crafting is shown in the image in the gallery), then craft a Seal (its crafting is shown in the image in the gallery) and place it IN YOUR INVENTORY, NOT IN THE QUICK ACCESS SLOTS. 2. After that, take the Blank Contract in your main hand and right-click. 3. To write a contract, type the text in the text field when opening the Blank Contract interface. Once you've written the contract, check the box next to "Read." After that, the contract will be written and all that's left to do is place the seal. 4. To place the seal, take the written contract in your main hand and right-click after the contract signing animation plays. 5. If the contract has been completed, it can be completed. Take the active contract in your main hand, right-click, and check the "Completed?" box. Currently, only one contract can be signed per player.
